item.description:
Pluck 1.0.1

  • Viewing a screenshot now always opens it in Preview, where Markup is. The Markup button is now called Preview, and Quick Look is gone from the menu, double-click and Space.
  • Screenshots you drag into an app now stay in your folder by default. Choose Remove in Settings to have them leave once dropped.
  • The small thumbnail beside the notch is now off by default, so Pluck stays out of sight until you need it. Turn it on in Settings.
  • New installs save screenshots to the Screenshots folder in Pictures, which needs no extra permission.
  • Onboarding shows the real Pluck preview when you choose between it and the macOS thumbnail, and ends with a quick guide to the notch.
  • Clearer, simpler wording throughout onboarding and Settings.

Pluck 1.0 is here.

Pluck lives in your notch and makes the screenshot you just took easy to use, then gets it out of your way.

In this first release:

  • Every screenshot appears in the notch, ready to copy, mark up, pin, or drag into any app
  • Hover the notch to peek at recent screenshots, or click it to open the Shelf and see them all
  • Old screenshots move to the Trash on your schedule, and pinned ones are always kept
  • Pluck only touches real screenshots, asks for one permission, and nothing leaves your Mac
